name: LLDAP
description: A lightweight LDAP server for user management with a web interface. For more information please visit the GitHub repository.

paths.name: Data path
paths.description: The default path for LLDAP configuration files, this is where your user configuration etc will be stored.

ports.name: Web front-end port
ports.description: The default port for the web front-end.

ports.name: LDAP port
ports.description: The default port for LDAP connections.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Set this to a random string of characters as it is used for your JWT secret.

variables.name: LDAP Admin Password
variables.description: The password for the default admin user. Please change this to something more secure.
